technical_and_design_decisions: Leverage published external Hyperledger Fabric Go modules (such as fabric-config, fabric-protos-go, and refactored fabric common packages) to replace vendored/copied internal code.
Update fabric-sdk-go dependency definitions in go.mod and go.sum, ensuring compatible versions of protobufs and fabric packages are referenced.
Refactor all package import paths across the SDK that currently point to internal/ and third_party/ directories to point to official external modules.
Remove obsolete copied code trees from internal/github.com/hyperledger/fabric/ and third_party/github.com/hyperledger/fabric/.
Implement packaging logic in the chaincode client component to detect and preserve go.mod files within chaincode source directories during deployment package creation (U6).
assumptions: Target external Go packages containing cauthdsl, ccprovider, ledger, configtxgen, configtxlator, and gossip utilities are available and stable in external repositories.
The Go SDK project uses Go modules (go.mod) for dependency management.
All work, including refactoring, unit test updates, integration testing against Hyperledger Fabric, and pull request preparation, will be completed by a single developer.
No breaking API changes to the public fabric-sdk-go interfaces will be introduced during this refactoring.

activities.activity_description: Audit existing SDK dependencies in go.mod, identify externalized Fabric packages, configure local development environment, and update module dependencies.
Remove internal copy under internal/github.com/hyperledger/fabric/gossip, update discovery client imports to use externalized gossip protoext, and adjust unit tests.
Remove third_party/github.com/hyperledger/fabric/common/cauthdsl, update callers to import the external cauthdsl package, and update corresponding unit tests.

activities.activity_name: Externalize ccprovider and Ledger Structures (U3, U4)
activities.activity_description: Remove third_party copies of ccprovider and core/ledger, update SDK struct references to externalized common modules, and verify compilation and unit tests.
Clean up internal copies under internal/.../common and internal/.../core, refactor all internal SDK callers to use externalized utilities, and fix failing tests.
Update chaincode packaging logic to check for and include go.mod files in chaincode packages as a temporary transition workaround, and add unit test coverage.

activities.activity_name: Externalize Configtxgen and Configtxlator Functions (U7, U8)
activities.activity_description: Remove copied code in pkg/fab/resource/configtx.go and sdkinternal/configtxgen/configtxlator, refactor config creation and translation components to use external libraries, and update tests.

activities.activity_name: Integration Testing, E2E Validation, and PR Refinement
activities.activity_description: Run the complete test suite including integration tests against a live Fabric network, perform regression testing, clean up unused files, and finalize documentation/PRs.
